questions.q: What is faceting in a CRM Analytics dashboard?
options: A selection on one widget automatically filters other widgets on the same dataset
A way to split a dashboard into separate apps
A SAQL function that groups rows by date
A security setting that hides datasets from users
questions.explain: Faceting lets selections on chart, date, list, range, and toggle widgets automatically filter other widgets, with no query editing.

questions.q: Which setting decides whether a click on this widget filters the other widgets?
options: Apply global filters
Broadcast selections as facets
Query limit
Initial selections
questions.explain: Broadcast selections as facets controls whether a widget's selections are sent out to filter others. Turning it off leaves the widget clickable without affecting the rest.

questions.q: Two widgets on a dashboard use different datasets, and you want a selection in one to change the other. What is the best approach?
options: Nothing is possible across datasets
Rely on faceting; it always connects every widget
Use a selection interaction (a binding) to connect them
Merge both dashboards into a native report
questions.explain: Faceting connects widgets on the same dataset by default. A binding lets one query's selection or result change part of another query, including across datasets.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of dashboard actions?
options: To speed up dataset refresh
To change the dashboard's color palette
To define row-level security
To take the viewer to a next step, such as a Salesforce record or global action
questions.explain: Interactions change what the dashboard shows; actions take the viewer somewhere else, such as a record or a Salesforce global action. Exact availability varies by widget and release.

questions.q: A chart click does not filter a table on the same dataset. What is a sensible first check?
options: Whether the chart broadcasts selections and the table's faceting is not set to None
Whether the dashboard has a title widget
Whether the dataset has more than 100 rows
Whether the viewer uses a mobile device
questions.explain: The source must broadcast its selections and the target must not have faceting set to None. Also check whether a global filter or initial selection is narrowing results.
